name: Paint Rumble
detailed_description:
Feature List

🔥 Special Feature – Online & Local Multiplayer! 🎨

Play Paint Rumble like never before! In addition to the classic local mode to challenge your friends on the same PC, now you can connect with the whole world with our online multiplayer mode!

✅ Create your own room and invite friends for epic battles.
✅ Join public matches and compete against players from around the globe.
✅ Fast-paced real-time action, full of strategy and power-ups!

Now, the fun has no limits – challenge, win, and paint the screen like a true champion!


Feature List

🌎 Special Highlight – Available in 6 Languages!

Paint Rumble is translated into English, Portuguese, Spanish, Russian, German, and Simplified Chinese.

The interface, menus, buttons, and all game information are 100% translated.

✅ Play with total comfort, fully understanding every option and command, no matter where you're from.

✅ Make the experience even more accessible for you and your friends around the world.

No barriers! Just fun, strategy, and lots of paint on the screen!


About the Game

Paint, Compete, and Win!

Welcome to Paint Rumble, the most colorful, chaotic, and fun party game you've ever seen! Here, quick reflexes, strategy, and lots of craziness decide who comes out on top.

The challenge? Simple (or maybe not): in insane 2-minute matches, paint the largest area of the screen with your color. Sounds easy... until your friends start painting over your work!

Choose Your Character and Jump into the Madness!

Join the fight with one of the four most charismatic paint warriors: 🎨 Wolfy – The blue wolf, fast and clever.
🎨 Quacky – The yellow duck, always excited!
🎨 Tigro – The green tiger, fierce and competitive.
🎨 Lucky – The purple mouse, small but quick!

Each brings their own color to the battle, but only one takes the victory!

Game Modes

🎮 Free-for-All – Every player for themselves! Whoever paints the most, wins!

🎮 Team Battle (2v2) – Form your duo and show who rules the arena!

How to Play?

✅ Control your character using keyboard or controller — your choice!

✅ Play against your friends or challenge the CPU in solo matches.

✅ Run, dodge, and paint as much as you can before others paint over your color!

✅ Crazy power-ups appear during matches — grab them before others and turn the game in your favor!

✅ Set how many rounds you want: best of 3, 4, or 5. The battle is yours!

Simple, Fun, and ADDICTIVE!

Paint Rumble is that kind of game that starts with laughs... and ends with screams like “STOP PAINTING OVER MY STUFF!”.

Whether on the couch with friends, online with the world, or solo against the CPU, one thing is guaranteed: frantic and competitive fun from start to finish!

Play with anyone… and get ready for chaos!

🌎 Online Multiplayer – Challenge players from around the world or create a private room and show your friends who rules the paint!

🛋️ Local Multiplayer (Couch Co-op) – Gather your friends, share the keyboard or connect controllers… and let the madness begin on the same screen!

Paint Rumble is the kind of game that looks simple… until it starts. Then it’s shouting, laughter, rivalry, revenge, and LOTS of paint flying everywhere!

✅ Easy to learn. Hard to put down.

✅ Perfect for testing reflexes, strategy… and your friends’ patience.

✅ Great for all ages — whether for a casual session or a serious battle for honor on the couch (or online).

And the best part? The game is fully ready for players worldwide, with a 100% translated interface in 6 languages: Portuguese, English, Spanish, German, Russian, and Simplified Chinese.

So… who’s gonna dominate the screen? Who’s gonna paint over whom? Who’s taking the crown?

There’s only one way to find out… join the chaos!

Author’s Letter

Letter from the Creator

You know… I was never that person who spent hours and hours playing video games. In my childhood, teenage years, and youth, games appeared only from time to time — simple, almost rare moments. But even so, there’s one game that left a mark on me. I didn’t spend endless hours playing it. It was just a few moments… but they were magical.

I remember it like it was yesterday. We were all together: my mom, my dad, my siblings… and sometimes even my school friends. All squeezed into one chair, sharing the same keyboard. Each of us using two little fingers, trying to control our characters in the middle of all the chaos. It was deliciously messy — and, at the same time, one of the most fun things I’ve ever experienced.

Laughter. Shouts of celebration. The panic when someone hit the wrong button. That silly fight over who would be the champion… or who was just there to get in the way. But above all, those were moments of connection. Of being together. Of creating memories that still live here, in my heart.

Years went by… and today, I have the chance to turn all of that into something real. This isn’t just a game. It’s an invitation. An invitation for you to experience this too. To laugh. To compete. To connect — with those you love, with your kids, with your friends, with your parents, with whoever is by your side… or even across the world.

Paint Rumble is, in truth, a tribute. A tribute to the joy of simple things. To the magic of being together. To those moments that, often, we only realize how special they were… when they become memories.

I sincerely hope this game helps you create memories like that. That one day, years from now, you’ll look back and think: “Wow… those moments were truly amazing.”

Thank you for being here. And above all… have fun.

With love,
The creator of Paint Rumble

short_description: Paint Rumble is a fast-paced party game where strategy and reflexes matter! Cover the most area in 2-minute battles, playing solo, in teams, or against friends locally or online. Choose Wolfy, Quacky, Tigro, or Lucky, grab power-ups, and use your agility to dominate the battlefield!
